name: ai-action-safeguard
description: A machine-to-machine action safety layer for AI agents. Evaluates planned actions against context deviation, risk, and policy before execution.

action_evaluation.description: Evaluate an AI agent action before execution.

context_deviation.description: Detect deviation between the original agent plan and the proposed action.

risk_evaluation.description: Evaluate action risk including access scope, financial impact, and irreversibility.

policy_evaluation.description: Evaluate actions against machine-readable policy rules.
